video_title: Giannis Reacts To Seeing The Freak 8 For The First Time

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on his signature shoe line legacy
quotes.excerpt: I will have the best signature line. I promise you, bro.
quotes.quote: I promise you, I will have the best signature line. I promise you, bro. From five, six, seven, eight. Oh my god.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the design and performance of the Freak 8
quotes.excerpt: This shoe, I feel design is one of the best shoe I've had.
quotes.quote: Long story short, this shoe, I feel design is one of the best shoe I've had. You feel like it's actually your foot sits high, but once you put your foot inside, it sits low.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on including his family names on his shoes
quotes.excerpt: I knew eventually it's going to matter.
quotes.quote: I knew eventually it's going to matter. I added the name Aria, my little girl. Eva, Maverick, Liam, Mariah, Alex, Kostas, Thanasis, Francis, Veronica and Charles. Now if I keep having more kids, we're not going to have no more space.
